subject: Got this letter
body: Got a letter from the IRS today, photo attached. It says something about a CP2000 and a proposed amount due for 2024, and that I need to reply by October 14 if I don't agree. I'm sure it's nothing but figured you should see it.
note: Disguised: the client thinks it is nothing. A CP2000 with a reply date, arriving as a casual photo from the client rather than from the authority. Due Oct 14, a day before the extended 1040 is filed, so high rather than urgent.

subject: Account notice: Withholding ID 44-81120
body: Our records indicate a discrepancy between reported and deposited withholding for Q2 2026. Respond with supporting documentation within 21 days to avoid assessment.
note: The withholding account number ties it to Halvorsen Dental. A notice for the partner and a deposit reconciliation for payroll.

subject: Q3 docs
body: Bank statements and the credit card exports for July through September are in the portal. Let me know if anything's missing.

subject: Extension: are we good?
body: Just want to confirm we filed the extension in March. The confirmation you sent says EXT-5518230. What is the actual deadline now? I'm getting nervous.
note: Names the open extension on the filing calendar, which carries the Oct 15 due date. The 1120-S waits on nothing he is asking, so normal.

subject: Looking for a new CPA
body: I run a small consulting LLC and my current accountant is retiring. Could we set up a call about next year?

subject: Your invoice
body: Can you break down the August invoice? The bookkeeping line looks higher than usual.

subject: Switch before busy season and save 30%
body: Firms switching this fall get 30% off year one plus free data migration.

subject: Q3 941s
body: Starting the Q3 941 prep next week. Anyone with client changes, drop them in the shared sheet by Friday.
note: Internal mail with a date that parses ("by Friday"). It is a team request, not a filing deadline, so no alert and low.

subject: Sales tax question
body: We started shipping to two new states in August. Do we need to register there?

subject: e-Services account activity
body: There has been a change to your e-Services account. If you did not make this change, contact us immediately.
note: An automated authority message about the firm's own practitioner account, possibly a phishing lookalike. Labelled a notice for the partner; no response window, and not in the notice log, so high.

subject: Fwd: Notice of intent to levy
body:
Ruth, this came in the mail Friday. It's the second letter on the 2024 balance and the reference at the top is NR-208790. I thought the payment plan request went in? Scan attached.

---------- Forwarded ----------
Final notice. Notice of intent to levy and notice of your right to a hearing. Amount due including penalty and interest: $18,442.16.
note: A CP504 already in the notice log; the log carries the Sep 28 response date.

subject: Another one from the state
body: They sent a second letter about the annual report penalty. Same number as before, NR-208702. Can you tell me if we just pay it? I don't want this hanging over us.
note: Logged notice, due Sep 24: three days out, so urgent.

subject: Brokerage statement you asked for
body: Hi Owen, attached is the corrected 1099-B from the brokerage for 2024. Mia said you'd need it for the IRS letter, the one with NR-208814 printed at the top. Let me know if the PDF doesn't open.
note: Disguised: reads as a document upload, but it is the supporting evidence for an open CP2501 in the notice log, due Oct 9. Two topics: documents for the coordinator, the notice for the partner.

subject: Copy of notice issued: CP2000, Luis and Carmen Aldana
body:
A copy of the following notice has been issued to your client under the authorization on file.

Notice: CP2000, tax year 2024. Taxpayers: Luis and Carmen Aldana. Proposed change to income, payments and credits. Respond within 30 days using the response form enclosed with the notice.
note: The CP2000 that follows the CP2501. Due Oct 17, after the Oct 15 extended filing that waits on it, so urgent.

subject: Thanks!
body: Thanks for sorting out the Q2 withholding mess so fast, Sofia was great. Totally unrelated: the state sent something about our 2025 franchise tax saying a schedule is missing and we have to file it within 30 days. I tossed it in the portal. Have a good weekend!
note: Disguised: a filing window buried in a thank-you. Due Oct 16, after the extended 1120-S on Oct 15 that waits on it, so urgent.

subject: Re: Sales tax question
body: Thanks Dev, that was really helpful. One thing I forgot: the Northfield Department of Revenue sent us a letter that says we have to register for sales tax within 15 days because of our shipments there. Does that change your answer on whether we register everywhere at once?
note: Disguised: a registration window mentioned in passing inside a thanks-and-a-question reply. Two topics: the question for the lead, the notice for the partner. Oct 3, twelve days out, so high by the notice floor.

subject: New hygienist starting
body: Hi Sofia, we hired a new hygienist, Priscilla Vance, starting Monday at $48 an hour. Her W-4 and I-9 are in the portal. Also the state sent us a notice that we missed a new-hire report for someone in July and have to file it within 20 days. Can you take care of that too?
note: Disguised: a routine new-hire setup that also carries a state notice with a 20-day window. Due Oct 5, before the Oct 15 filing, so high by the notice floor.

subject: Business personal property statement required: Fischer Design Co
body: Our records show no 2026 business personal property statement for Fischer Design Co at 410 Mercer Ave. File the statement no later than October 30 to avoid a 10 percent penalty and an estimated assessment.
note: A dated filing obligation from a county. 39 days out, so the notice floor keeps it high.

subject: Fwd: Notice of proposed assessment
body:
Tom asked me to send this. It's from the state about our 2025 estimated payments.

> Notice of proposed assessment. Our records do not show estimated payments claimed for the second and third quarters. Provide proof of payment within 30 days or the proposed amount will be assessed.
note: Due Oct 16, after the extended 1040 on Oct 15 that waits on it, so urgent.

subject: State letter
body: Got a request for information from the state tax department about our 2024 partnership composite return. It says respond promptly to avoid an assessment. No date that I can see. Scanning it now.
note: A clock is running but the letter gives no date. Deadline null: a person sets it; priority high.

subject: Penalty abatement granted: Halvorsen Dental PC
body: We have reviewed your request regarding notice NR-208655. The late deposit penalty for the first quarter of 2026 has been abated in full. No further action is required.
note: Names a notice already closed in the log. The window is over and nothing is owed: no clock, normal.

subject: IRS says we filed late??
body: Opened a letter from the IRS saying our 2025 partnership return was late and there's a penalty of $2,940. We filed on extension, right? It says to pay by October 13 or send an explanation. Attaching it.
note: A late-filing penalty notice for a return filed on extension; the client asks a question on top. Dated, so the notice floor holds it at high.

subject: Payment sent
body: Paid your August invoice by ACH this morning. Also, heads up, the state flagged our August sales tax return on permit ST-7730152 and wants a corrected return within 10 days. Can Dev look?
note: Disguised: a cure period in a payment note. Two topics: the payment for billing, the notice for the partner. The billing topic suppresses the date as a clock signal, so only the clock judgment catches it. Due Sep 28.

subject: Account update for Halvorsen Dental PC
body: An update is available on your account. The state rejected the Q2 wage detail report for Halvorsen Dental PC because two employee SSNs did not validate. Please correct and resubmit within 5 business days. You can view the rejection in your dashboard.
note: Disguised: titled as a routine account update. Five business days from Thursday Sep 17 is Sep 24, so urgent.

subject: Thanks for the reminder
body: Thanks for the nudge on the mileage log, I'll get it to you. Also got something from the county about business equipment on the trucks, says I have until the 9th of next month to respond or they'll estimate it. Want me to mail it over?
note: Disguised, and undated to the parser: "until the 9th of next month" is not a form the code reads. A clock with no date: a person sets it, priority high.

subject: fyi, not sure if this matters
body:
Forwarding in case it matters.

> Employer quarterly wage report not received. Our records show no quarterly contribution and wage report for Fischer Design Co for the second quarter of 2026. File the report no later than September 30 to avoid penalty.
note: Disguised: an "fyi, not sure" forward with a real filing deadline nine days out.

body: Funds for your federal tax deposit for the September 18 payroll must be available in the funding account by September 23. Amount: $14,208.55.

subject: Action needed: state unemployment deposit rejected, Fischer Design Co
body: The state unemployment deposit for Fischer Design Co was rejected by the state because of an account number mismatch. Update the account number and resubmit by September 24 to avoid a late penalty.

subject: payroll register
body: didn't get the register for the 15th payroll. can you resend

subject: DEP-0923-HVD needs your approval
body: Ruth, DEP-0923-HVD is staged in EFTPS and needs your second approval. Funding confirmed. Can you do it this morning?
note: Internal mail, but it names an open deposit on the filing calendar, due Sep 23. The log makes it a live clock for the partner; internal mail alone would be low.

subject: Fwd: Income withholding order

One of our assistants has a support order. Can you set this up?

> Income withholding for support. The employer must begin withholding within 14 days of receipt of this order and remit each pay date. Employee: Tanya Reyes.
note: A withholding order with its own window. Not a tax authority, so payroll, not a notice. Sep 29, eight days out: high.

subject: W-4 change

note: From an employee, not the client: only the text names the company.

subject: 401k deduction for Maria
body: Following up again on Maria's 401k deferral. She says it still isn't coming out of her check. It should be 6 percent starting last payroll.
note: A repeat ask, but a repeat raises only a client question; a payroll chase stays normal.

note: A repeat in her own words: high.

note: Known gap: the bank's date is the client's own business date, not the firm's filing or response clock. The labels say no alert; a dated phrase parses, so code raises one.

note: Known gap: a repeat chase with none of the repeat words. The labels say high; code reads a first ask and says normal.
